title: Magic and Non-Clifford Gates in Topological Quantum Field Theory
summary: Non-Clifford gates, used to generate quantum magic, are essential for universal quantum computation. We show that non-Clifford gates arise naturally from path integrals in topological quantum field theories, where their magic-generating properties are determined by the algebraic data of the theory. In Chern-Simons theory, we construct the Ising interaction gate, whose generator is prepared by path integration over simple three-boundary manifolds, and show that it produces non-local magic away from discrete Clifford points.
